long_biography.plain_text:
By the time Giovanni Tamburi left Euromobiliare, he had spent more than a decade in investment and merchant banking and reached senior management. In 1991 he set up independently, focusing on corporate-finance advice for mid-sized Italian businesses. That practice was later combined with an investment company designed to supply minority equity and strategic advice without the fixed exit timetable typical of conventional funds.

The resulting TIP model brought entrepreneurial families and institutional shareholders into a listed permanent-capital platform. Tamburi built its portfolio around active stakes in Italian manufacturers, consumer brands, travel companies and technology businesses, frequently supporting acquisitions, international expansion and stock-market listings. He also taught corporate finance and has written several books on business valuation, governance and Italy's entrepreneurial system. He continues to lead TIP while serving on boards across its investment network.
